question: What is the current release of Autodesk Inventor?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Inventor 2027.2, the current release as of November 2026; the sources don't state a build number [1]. Autodesk's blog post dated November 3, 2026 covers it [1], and a forum post dated November 10, 2026 says it "was released today" and is available from Autodesk Account or Access [7]. It follows the 2027 release from spring 2026 [1] and the 2027.1 update [3].

The 2027.2 update adds Autodesk Assistant improvements, including file uploads, plus assembly constraint and Model State enhancements [1]. The forum post also lists remote MCP server configuration and out-of-process Python scripting through the Inventor API [7].
